reviews.text: Always a great experience. Highly recommend.
My frenchie gets her nails cut in this groomers. The staff here always take her without an appointment and are very kind and friendly 😊 …
My puppy looks gorgeous, thanks 😌 the only problem, they only take cash. …
Thank you for a lovely review! Much appreciated 😊 …
The ladies do a fantastic job here. Can't recommend them enough.
Super friendly staff great groomers and a positive experience for nervous pets .

Firstly, staff very friendly on the phone. Our dog very badly needed grooming and Glamour Dogs did an amazing job,  he looks beautiful altogether, a lot less vacuuming now around the house. I got a call when our dog ready and to pick up when good for me. We have used Glamour Dogs many times and will be back again. Thanks so much to lovely staff. Patty
Staff are all so nice and helpful!
They were gentle on my Puppy. Clipping her nails very gently and distracting her when she was upset about it. Very friendly and gentle ladies.
Always good. They actually listen to what you want for dog.

This is the best groomers in Dublin in my opinion. It is very hard to get an appointment because they are so good. My dog loves all the girls, they do an amazing job de shedding him. He is delighted with himself lol I cannot praise them enough. Love them
